intro: Every public meeting where Smith County's money decisions get made — the Commissioners Court and the Tyler City Council — listed as they're confirmed.

recurring.name: Smith County Commissioners Court
recurring.place: Commissioners Courtroom, Annex Building (first floor), 200 E Ferguson St, Tyler
recurring.note: The County Judge and four commissioners, who adopt the county budget and set the tax rate. Agendas at smith-county.com/285/Commissioners-Court-Agendas; live stream at smith-county.com/287.
recurring.source: Day, time, and room from the Commissioners Court page, smith-county.com/275/Commissioners-Court (checked September 2026).

unverified.name: Tyler City Council
unverified.note: Agendas, minutes, and video at cityoftyler.org (Mayor & Council → Agendas and Notices). Regular schedule to be pinned from the city's own posting.

seasonal.banner: Budget season: from the June workshops through adoption in mid-September, the Commissioners Court writes next year's county budget and tax rate. Public hearings come in August and early September. Anything you want changed in the numbers gets said in these meetings — or waits a year.

community.invite: Community events belong here too — send them through the question box.
